summary: cdecl string-to-integer parser with whitespace skip. Advances past leading whitespace (character-type category 8), consumes an optional '+'/'-' sign, then accumulates decimal digits (category 4) into an integer value and returns it negated when the sign was '-'. Character classification is versioned by the cbMultiByte global: the off_5E69C8 table is used when cbMultiByte <= 1, otherwise CharacterEncodingConvertViaLookupTableFallback. Called by 24 per-frame/parse-time consumers including RaceCommentaryDirectorSystem and SessionConfigReader.

operations.description: Skip leading whitespace: while the current character *a1 matches character-type category 8 (looked up in off_5E69C8 when cbMultiByte <= 1, else via CharacterEncodingConvertViaLookupTableFallback(*a1, 8)), advance a1.
Read the first non-whitespace byte v3 = *a1, set the scan pointer v4 = a1 + 1, and preserve the original byte v5 = v3 for the later sign check.
If v3 is '+' (43) or '-' (45), consume the sign and load the next byte v3 = *v4++.

Parse digits: initialize v6 = 0, then while the current character v3 matches digit category 4 (off_5E69C8 lookup when cbMultiByte <= 1, else CharacterEncodingConvertViaLookupTableFallback(v3, 4)), accumulate and advance v4.
Accumulate decimal value per digit: v6 = v3 + 10 * v6 - 48 (subtracting ASCII '0').
Return -v6 when the original sign byte v5 was '-' (45); otherwise return the parsed value v6.
